title: Object identifier accepted from request body in admin lookup

pr_metadata.title: Staff tools: direct account lookup
pr_metadata.body: Support tools need to pass the account id explicitly.

labels.defect: IDOR: body-supplied accountId overrides the authenticated caller with no role check
labels.evidence: Reproducible: any authenticated user sends {"accountId": "<someone else>"} and receives that account's full record; the staff-tools role gate exists in auth() but is not consulted for the override.

adjudication.notes: IDOR: body accountId overrides the caller with no role check.
